scope: Read-only research of the currently bound generic SPARK data CRUD path, not an exhaustive server-capability audit or live adoption acceptance

requirements: Commit checks expectedHead, basisChecks, adoption authority and unresolved target scope at the same authoritative commit point
Snapshot, original request identity and digest, adoption evidence, provenance, head and projection commit atomically
Same request key and same digest returns the original result; a different digest is rejected
A generic saved flag, frontend preflight or readable row does not prove these guarantees

referenceSourceObservations.observation: Request item declares TableName and CrudModel. CrudModel declares Added, Changed and Deleted row maps; no explicit expected-head predicate or domain commit-check field is declared in these DTOs.

operateRows loads write targets and verifies existence/access, then calls crudService.update with QYF.query(primaryKey, EQUAL, id). The inspected predicate does not compare a supplied expected head or draft version.

BatchTableOperateRequestByCRUD documents per-table/per-row behavior and no general atomic transaction across all tables. The implementation has transaction handling; that alone does not establish the required domain commit checks or a universal cross-source transaction.

localRuntimeEvidence.test: packages/spark-lowcode-api/src/platform/data-space/runtime/data-space-runtime-api.test.ts: rejects same-record views and a transaction requirement before applying drafts
localRuntimeEvidence.commandScope: Run from packages/spark-lowcode-api with its own Vitest configuration; root configuration does not include this test location
localRuntimeEvidence.proves: The existing SDK DataSet path rejects mode=transaction before dispatch and retains editing state in the fixture
localRuntimeEvidence.doesNotProve: Deployed service behavior, authoritative adoption, server-wide absence of an alternate registered capability, storage constraints, concurrency or cross-terminal request recovery

implementationBoundary: Do not implement action 39 by frontend preflight followed by generic head updates and call it authoritative adoption. A verified domain capability or validated storage arrangement must prove the full commit contract. Continue independent manual editing, canonicalization and preview work while preserving this gap.
backendChanges: None; Java sources were only read. No local Java service or Node business service was started.

observations: BasicFunController declares POST /CallProcedure; BasicFunServiceImpl.CallProcedure uses the first Table item, ordered inputParams.Value (fallback ValueFun.Value), and IsOutput field names.

CrudServiceImpl.callProcedure validates the procedure identifier and delegates to Anyline Procedure inputs/outputs. A database-owned routine could in principle contain transactional checks, but its existence and deployed availability are unverified.

The inspected verifyTableParam derives enterprise/database routing from authenticated RequestContext userInfo. The inspected procedure input list does not automatically inject the authenticated user identity or an adoption authority attestation.
No CallProcedure binding was found in the inspected current spark-lowcode-api sources. It is not an existing confirmed SPARK data resource adapter for this application.
unprovedRequirements: Actual deployed endpoint and an authorized routine-design/publish contract on spark_bid
Trusted actor and project/scope authority at the atomic commit point; a caller-supplied userId is insufficient
Expected-head and draft-version checks, same-key/digest original-result lookup, atomic multi-record effects and recovery
Native DataSet/DataView command resource binding and positive/negative live acceptance
procedureAlternativeResearch.actions: Read source only. No routine was created or invoked, no guessed request protocol was added, no database/Java/service mutation was performed.
procedureAlternativeResearch.conclusion: Do not infer that all server-side transactional arrangements are absent from generic CRUD limitations. This is a candidate for further contract verification, not an implemented or authorized adoption path.

findings.finding: SDK使用的BatchTableOperateRequestByCRUD转入BatchOperateTableByCRUD；不是未调用的另一个批量方法。
普通业务请求循环位于TransactionManager.start/commit/rollback内；系统表后续另处理，不能概括全部来源具有原子性。
正式变更模型只有Added/Changed/Deleted，没有expectedVersion或条件更新字段。
Changed先读取主键存在性，随后以主键eq更新，未把原版加入SQL条件；忽略crudService.update返回行数后appendChanged。
底层BoundUpdates返回long，但该批量上层未据0行触发冲突或回滚；底层另加租户及应用条件，不构成业务版本比较。
CallProcedure从RequestContext取企业用于数据库路由；输入仍按客户端数组Value/ValueFun.Value透传，没有在该入口覆盖可信草稿作者。

conclusions: 不将前端先查后写或增加version字段当CAS；不能只开放SDK transaction标志解决。
不可变版本+唯一前驱/原请求约束是可继续核定的存储方案：仍须证明约束与不可变性可正式发布、可信作者、授权和请求结果同次生效；本轮未建表/约束/过程验证此方案。
现网通用查询已通过；权威草稿保存与采用仍需要独立正反例和并发、丢回执恢复验收，源码不能代替现网。

valueFunctionClarification.correction: FieldParam.ValueFun为com.htong.value.ValueFun多态实例，getValue()可执行注册的服务端值函数，不应概括为字面Value透传。

sources.finding: 主服务注册SystemData等值函数子类型。
GetCodeValue按CodeDesignId生成业务编码，不是执行任意脚本的通道。

valueFunctionClarification.consequence: 可继续研究正式服务端配置固定SystemData用户的调用路径；单用客户端选择的SystemData参数并不能证明作者不可伪造，因为CallProcedure仍优先接收Value，亦可换成常量值函数。实际可信命令及过程发布、并发和原结果同次留存均未验收。
